texts.zh:
我们在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站汇报，在最近一次地表地址调查之后丢失了一个补给箱。

在追踪补给箱地理定位的过程中，我们发现它被一座当地村庄发现并占为己有。

我们补给箱的混入可能对[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的发展带来不利影响。
texts.en:
Our observation post above [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported missing supply crates following a recent geological survey on the surface.

While tracking the geolocators on the supplies, we have discovered that a local village has found and claimed these resources for themselves.

The introduction of our storage containers may have an adverse effect on the development of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前FTL物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-FTL species appears here.

texts.zh:
看来，误入[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的补给箱存对当地文化产生了奇怪的影响。

当地[Root.GetPreFTLUpper]居民建造了我们观测飞船的粗糙仿制品。虽然这些“船”显然没有功能，但这证明我们的研究人员在调查期间被当地人发现了。

在一位当地长老的指导下，可以看到[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]队模仿我们的地质土壤分析程序：把我们不当处置的板条箱装满泥土和岩石，把它们装上他们的“船”，耐心地等待。
texts.en:
It would appear that the misplaced inventory on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has had a strange impact on the native culture.

The [Root.GetPreFTLUpper] population has built crude imitations of our own observation shuttles. While these "ships" are obviously non functional, this is evidence that our researchers were spotted by locals during their survey.

Under the guidance of a local elder, the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] can be seen performing an imitation of our geological soil analysis procedure: filling our misplaced crates we left behind with dirt and rocks, loading them onto their "ships", and waiting patiently.

texts.zh: [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]以为模仿我们的行为，就会有更多的货物出现。我们应该在这种行为对社会造成更大影响之前进行干预。
texts.en: The [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] are under the impression that by mimicking our processes, more supplies will appear. We should intervene before this behavior impacts their wider society.

texts.zh: 这么做就是徒劳，等来的只会有死亡。
texts.en: This practice is ultimately futile, only death awaits.

label.zh: 用食物交换他们的矿物。
label.en: Exchange food supplies for their minerals.

texts.zh:
从[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]取回我们丢失的箱子后，装载“飞船”的仪式仍持续了一阵子，直到[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]愤怒地找到村庄长老，然后把他们丢进仿造的“穿梭机”并烧成了灰烬。

尽管人们已经回归了此前的日常，但他们的文化里对“天人”的怨恨仍然挥之不去。
texts.en:
After recovering our lost crates from [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the "ship" loading rituals continued for a short while, until the angry [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] locals turned on their village elder, throwing them into the makeshift shuttle before burning it to ashes.

Although the population has returned to their previous routines, their culture retains a lingering resentment towards the "sky people".

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前FTL物种的复数名称。
note.en: In the game, the plural name of this pre-FTL species appears here.

texts.zh:
随着[Root.GetPreFTLLower][event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]社会的发展，我们停止了从观测站与他们进行的资源交换。

尽管这是一个很有趣的实验，继续影响他们的社会只会让我们过早地暴露在他们面前。
texts.en:
As the [Root.GetPreFTLLower] [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] society advances, we have discontinued our exchange of rations for minerals from our observation post.

Despite being an interesting experiment, the continued interference with their civilization only risks exposing our presence to them prematurely.

summary.text:
# 遗落之物 / What We Left Behind

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/strange_worlds_observation_events.txt:419-701`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:195,5540`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每月观测事件池（on_monthly_pulse_pre_ftl_observation）权重100（总权重2860），由前超光速科技进步局势的 preftl.50（5/100每月）触发（见前超光速观测故事）；分派事件按年代、观测任务与一次性标志把关。
  The monthly observation pool (on_monthly_pulse_pre_ftl_observation) with weight 100 (of 2860), fed by preftl.50 of the pre-FTL tech-progress situation (5/100 per month; see the pre-FTL observation stories); the dispatcher checks age, observation mission and a once-only flag.
- 隐藏分派 strange_worlds.3035：没有进行中的观测事件链，年代在石器到晚期中世纪，观测站任务为“样本采集”，观测站所有者尚未触发本事件（triggered_crate_expectations）。
  Hidden dispatcher strange_worlds.3035: no ongoing observation chain, age Stone to Late Medieval, observation mission "specimen collection", observer has not had this event (triggered_crate_expectations).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 3040「我们遗留的东西」：箱子被他们得到 → 3045「退还寄件人」：a 秘密回收（180天后 3050「怨恨的缺席」）；b 用食物（-500）换矿物，违反不干涉并设“服务终止”标志；c（灭绝型）灭绝式处理，使其倒退一个时代。
  3040 "What We Left Behind": the crates fell into their hands -> 3045 "Return to Sender": a covertly recover them (3050 "Resentful Absence" 180 days later); b trade food (-500) for minerals, breaching non-interference and setting the canceled-service flag; c (homicidal) cull them, regressing their age.
- 选项 b 之后，该文明进入文艺复兴时代时 on_ftl_society_enters_new_age → 3055（隐藏）→ 180天后 3060「服务终止」。
  After option b, when the civilization enters the Renaissance age on_ftl_society_enters_new_age -> 3055 (hidden) -> 3060 "Canceled Service" 180 days later.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- a、b、c 三个选项互斥；3050 与 3060 不会同时发生。
  Options a, b, c are exclusive; 3050 and 3060 do not both happen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项取决于是否灭绝型、是否巨型企业。
  Options depend on homicidal and megacorp status.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：分派条件、选项与标志、3055 的 on_action 衔接。
  Checked: dispatcher conditions, options and flags, the on_action link to 3055.
- 更正：3055（服务终止）原为孤立故事，其触发标志由3045.b设置，现并入。
  Correction: 3055 (canceled service) was an isolated story; its trigger flag is set by 3045.b, so it is merged here.
